shortDescription: Configures a SQL Login in a Microsoft SQL Server instance.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Specifies whether the SQL Login is enabled. Only valid when C(state=present).

options.name: login_host
options.description: The hostname of the SQL Server instance to configure.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the SQL Server instance.

options.name: login_password_expiration_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether the SQL Login password expiration policy is enabled. Only valid when C(state=present) and C(type=sql).

options.name: login_password_policy_enforced
options.description: Specifies whether the SQL Login password policy is enforced. Only valid when C(state=present) and C(type=sql).

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port on which the SQL Server instance is listening.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the SQL Server instance.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the SQL Login to configure.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the SQL Login. Only valid when C(state=present) and C(type=sql). Required when C(state=present) and C(type=sql).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the SQL Login.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of login to configure.

options.name: update_password
options.description: Specifies when to update the password. Only valid when C(state=present) and C(type=sql).
